name: Parameters.instWeilDataE
summary: A splitting character exists because every root of unity ζ(P, s)^k is δ/δ̄ for δ = (ζ(P, s)^m(ζ(P, s) − 1))^k, m = N₁(P, s)/4, a unit of norm 1 over K; then j = −1/√−d(P) and α(P, s) satisfy the conditions of Weil data, the self-duality coming from v_w(α ᾱ relDifferentGen(P, s)) = 1 and the different (relDifferentGen(P, s)·√−d(P)).

steps.claim: Choose a splitting character υ of E (`nonempty_splittingChar`): it exists once every root of unity y of E satisfies y·conj(δ) = δ for some unit δ of 𝓞_E with ∏_w Φ_w(δ) = 1.
steps.lean:
have := (nonempty_splittingChar fun (y : P.E s) h ↦
    (exists_zeta_pow_eq h).choose_spec.2 ▸ let m := P.N₁ s / 4
    have N : Algebra.norm P.K (P.zetaInt s ^ m * (P.zetaInt s - 1)).val = 1 := by erw [map_mul,
                isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.sub_one_norm_eq_eval_cyclotomic, map_pow,
      isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.norm_eq_one, one_pow,
      eval_one_cyclotomic_not_prime_pow fun _ _ _ ↦ ?_] <;> grind [Parameters, ne (P.N₁ s),
      Nat.prime_eq_prime_of_dvd_pow, Nat.prime_two, Nat.prime_three, irreducible_cyclotomic]
    ⟨((RingOfIntegers.isUnit_norm _).1 ⟨1, ext N.symm⟩).unit ^
      (exists_zeta_pow_eq h).choose, by simp [↓prod_phi_eq_norm,
      N, -map_mul], congr($(show P.zetaInt s ^ _ * star _ = _ by simp [← mul_pow]; congr 1; grind
      [star_zetaInt_pow_mul 1, (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt.pow one_le (by grind [Parameters] :
      P.N₁ s = m * 2 * 2)).eq_neg_one_of_two_right, star_zetaInt_pow_mul, pow_mul']))⟩).some

steps.claim: Write y = ζ(P, s)^k with k < N₁(P, s) (`exists_zeta_pow_eq`), and let m = N₁(P, s)/4.

N_{E/K}(ζ(P, s)^m·(ζ(P, s) − 1)) = 1 — exactly 1, as the splitting-character criterion asks for relative norm one: N(ζ(P, s)) = 1 (`norm_eq_one`, N₁(P, s) ≠ 2), and N(ζ(P, s) − 1) = Φ_{N₁(P, s)}(1) with positive sign (`sub_one_norm_eq_eval_cyclotomic`, for N₁(P, s) > 2 and Φ_{N₁(P, s)} irreducible over K; equivalently (−1)^{φ(N₁(P, s))} = 1), and Φ_{N₁(P, s)}(1) = 1 because N₁(P, s) is not a prime power (2 and 3 both divide it).
steps.lean:
have N : Algebra.norm P.K (P.zetaInt s ^ m * (P.zetaInt s - 1)).val = 1 := by erw [map_mul,
                isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.sub_one_norm_eq_eval_cyclotomic, map_pow,
      isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.norm_eq_one, one_pow,
      eval_one_cyclotomic_not_prime_pow fun _ _ _ ↦ ?_] <;> grind [Parameters, ne (P.N₁ s),
      Nat.prime_eq_prime_of_dvd_pow, Nat.prime_two, Nat.prime_three, irreducible_cyclotomic]

steps.claim: Take δ = u^k with u = ζ(P, s)^m(ζ(P, s) − 1), a unit (its norm is a unit); ∏_w Φ_w(δ) = N_{E/K}(δ) = 1 (`prod_phi_eq_norm`, 1.2), and y·conj(δ) = δ follows from 1.3.1.
steps.lean:
⟨((RingOfIntegers.isUnit_norm _).1 ⟨1, ext N.symm⟩).unit ^
      (exists_zeta_pow_eq h).choose, by simp [↓prod_phi_eq_norm,
      N, -map_mul], congr($(show P.zetaInt s ^ _ * star _ = _ by simp [← mul_pow]; congr 1; grind
      [star_zetaInt_pow_mul 1, (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt.pow one_le (by grind [Parameters] :
      P.N₁ s = m * 2 * 2)).eq_neg_one_of_two_right, star_zetaInt_pow_mul, pow_mul']))⟩).some

steps.claim: ζ(P, s)^k·conj(u)^k = u^k: indeed ζ(P, s)·conj(u) = u, because conj(u) = ζ(P, s)^{−m}(ζ(P, s)^{−1} − 1) = −ζ(P, s)^{−m−1}(ζ(P, s) − 1) (`star_zetaInt_pow_mul`) and ζ(P, s)^{2m+1} = −ζ(P, s), as ζ(P, s)^{N₁(P, s)/2} = −1 (N₁(P, s) = 4m).
steps.lean:
show P.zetaInt s ^ _ * star _ = _ by simp [← mul_pow]; congr 1; grind
      [star_zetaInt_pow_mul 1, (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt.pow one_le (by grind [Parameters] :
      P.N₁ s = m * 2 * 2)).eq_neg_one_of_two_right, star_zetaInt_pow_mul, pow_mul']

steps.claim: So the hypothesis of `nonempty_splittingChar` holds; take the splitting character it provides.
The Weil data: j = −1/√−d(P) (√−d(P) = sqrtNegDInE(P, s)) and the idele α(P, s); the conditions conj(j) = −j and Im Φ_w(j) > 0 are left as goals.
steps.lean:
use -(P.sqrtNegDInE s).val⁻¹, ?_, ?_, P.α s, fun w ↦ by simpa [field,
    different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul, ← v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation,
    v_algebraMap_eq_valuation] using (congr($(v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen ..) /
    $(w.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity (ne_zero_of_differentIdeal_eq_span
    different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul)))), by simp [sqrtNegDInE, map_ofNat, isIntegral_coe],
    exists_eq_principalIdele_mul_norm.2.2 <;> simp [← map_star_CM, pos]

steps.claim: Self-duality at a finite place w: v_w(α·ᾱ·relDifferentGen(P, s)) = 1 (`v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen`: additive order 0) and the different is (relDifferentGen(P, s)·√−d(P)) (`different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul`), whose w-adic valuation is exp(−m_w), m_w the multiplicity of w in it; dividing (j = −1/√−d(P)) gives v_w(j·α·ᾱ) = exp(m_w), i.e. additive order −m_w (`.exp` encodes an integer in the value group ℤᵐ⁰).
steps.lean:
fun w ↦ by simpa [field,
    different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul, ← v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation,
    v_algebraMap_eq_valuation] using (congr($(v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen ..) /
    $(w.intValuation_eq_exp_neg_multiplicity (ne_zero_of_differentIdeal_eq_span
    different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul)))),

steps.claim: At a finite place w with conj(w) = w, the splitting character takes the value −1 at the chosen uniformiser idele π_w of w (`υ.atUnif w`, `exists_eq_principalIdele_mul_norm`); π_w is local, not the global generator ϖ(P, s) of the different.
The goals left open: conj(j) = −j (√−d(P) is purely imaginary) and Im Φ_w(j) > 0 (Φ_w commutes with conjugation and Φ_w(√−d(P)) = i√d(P), so Φ_w(j) = i/√d(P)).
